name: buddy
description: A small floating buddy that writes and fixes English in any app
author: akshatgg

scripts.build:icon: mkdir -p art/out && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender --background --factory-startup --python art/render_icon.py -- --out art/out/robot.png && swift build/MakeIcon.swift art/out/robot.png build/icon.png
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:native && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
